acceptanceCriteria: After a full `go test -count=1 ./internal/tasks/dispatch` run, no process started by those tests remains (checked by process group or a recorded pid list).
Each test registers cleanup that stops and reaps its host and worker processes, including on t.Fatal paths.
A maintained check fails if a dispatch test leaves a descendant process alive.
body:
Filed 2026-10-07 by the orchestrator session from the beamfall/corvint#651 lane (branch claude/gh651, base 79536edd, head 5d1f7167; go1.27.1, darwin arm64).

Observed by the lane after `go test ./internal/tasks/dispatch`: TestCALV0127_Reload* leaves orphan `sleep 300` processes and TestCALV0143 leaves its host.sh worker running. Expected: every process a test starts is stopped and reaped by t.Cleanup, so repeated runs do not accumulate processes or CPU load (which also feeds the load-sensitive flakes under V1-0849). Actual: the processes outlive the test binary until killed by hand.
title: tests: TestCALV0127_Reload* and TestCALV0143 leave worker processes running after the test ends
